translation: The accumulation that came out was no longer great lumps and long strips, and there was nothing more to distinguish. Tracing back the reason, after the head was clear, it was like removing the lid of a jar; all the accumulation below had to disperse upward, going to the jaw and down to the Renying point. That is, the jueyin liver channel arises at the big toe, goes up from the leg, winds around the genitals, reaches the lower abdomen, enters the stomach, belongs to the liver, connects with the gallbladder, and runs up through the diaphragm. Its accumulation is not yet much, spread over the flanks and ribs, seeking the throat; if the flanks and ribs are many, the accumulation is also many, and it must disperse clear upward through the jaw before it can go up to the upper throat and enter the eye system.
